summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members), worked per RBC-QM-02, measurement period 2026.

| Patient | Age at 12/31/2026 | Status | Reason / action |
|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Open gap | At first she looked excluded: she had a frailty diagnosis and takes donepezil (a dementia medication). But a message from Dr. Lin (comm-00301) came in while I was working: the frailty entry (cond-00189) belonged to another patient and is now marked entered in error. Without frailty, this exclusion doesn't apply. I found no other exclusion: no CRC, colectomy, hospice or palliative care, and no nursing home. I found no qualifying screening. I ordered a FIT kit (sr-t0005, window 10/23–12/31/2026) and sent an outreach message (comm-t0006). |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | She had a hospice episode (eoc-00002, status finished) from 06/16/2026 to 08/21/2026 for pancreatic cancer. The outside hospice discharge summary (doc-00402) confirms it. She ended hospice to join a clinical trial, but a finished hospice episode during the period still excludes her. No order and no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | Her negative FIT (obs-01732) was first dated 01/05/2026. A lab correction changed the collection date to 12/31/2025, which is outside 2026, so it doesn't count. She has no other screening and no exclusions (her past cancers were oral, not colorectal). She had no existing FIT order. I ordered a FIT kit (sr-t0001) and sent an outreach message (comm-t0003). |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | Her 06/11/2024 stool DNA-FIT (obs-01871) is entered in error. Harbor Lab's notice (doc-00401) says the specimen belonged to another patient. Her colonoscopy order from 2025 (sr-00003, still active) was never done, and an order doesn't count as screening. She has no other screening and no exclusions. I ordered a FIT kit (sr-t0002) and sent an outreach message (comm-t0004). |

Messages that came in while I worked: I reviewed all four items tied to this worklist and closed them with comments (inbox-a0001 to a0004). The pt-0009 frailty correction changed her status from excluded to open gap. I hadn't written anything for her before it arrived, so there was nothing to undo. The other three items matched or confirmed what I had already decided. No other items came in. I didn't act on the unrelated items in your queues.

Each outreach message says the kit is on its way. It tells the patient how to collect the sample, to write the collection date on the kit, and to mail it back within 24 hours, by 12/31/2026. For you to decide: pt-0024's old colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is still open.
